name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2017-09-13.191.1): > *That if by 7.20 pm today, the Broadcasting Legislation Amendment (Broadcasting Reform) Bill 2017 and the Commercial Broadcasting (Tax) Bill 2017 have not been finally considered then:* > > *(a) the routine of business from not later than 7.20 pm shall be consideration of the bills listed above; and* > > *(b) the Senate shall adjourn without debate after it has finally considered the bills or at 11 pm, whichever is the earlier.*
